content:
{'text': 'Apple 今日為 iPhone 推出新版本嘅「Apple Invites」app。今次更新加入咗 iOS 27 嘅新功能，包括強化嘅相片分享功能同對 Image Playground 嘅改進。', 'translate': 'Apple today released a new version of the "Apple Invites" app for iPhone. This update adds new features from iOS 27, including enhanced photo sharing capabilities and improvements to Image Playground.'}

{'text': '以下係 Apple 今日發佈嘅「Apple Invites」完整更新說明：', 'translate': 'Here are Apple\'s full release notes for "Apple Invites" released today:'}

  • {'text': '共享相簿而家支援全解像度分享，等你可以喺 app 內以極緻清晰度重溫每個時刻。任何人都可以加入並分享相片，就算唔係用 Apple 裝置嘅用戶都可以。', 'translate': "Shared Albums now support full-resolution sharing, allowing you to relive every moment in stunning clarity within the app. Anyone can join and contribute photos, even if they don't use Apple devices."}
  • {'text': 'Image Playground 而家可以幫你創造各種風格嘅高品質背景，包括超寫實選項，等你嘅邀請可以完美呈現你想要嘅氣氛。', 'translate': 'Image Playground can now help you create high-quality backgrounds in any aesthetic, including photorealistic options, so your invitations can perfectly capture the mood you want.'}
  • {'text': '需要驗證電郵嘅賓客而家只需喺收件匣點擊連結即可完成程序，唔使再輸入驗證碼，令出席活動更加方便。', 'translate': 'Guests who need to verify their email can now simply click the link in their inbox to complete the process, no longer needing to enter a verification code, making attending events easier.'}
  • {'text': '今次更新包含錯誤修正同效能改善。', 'translate': 'This update includes bug fixes and performance improvements.'}

{'text': '你可以喺 App Store 下載「Apple Invites」。建立邀请需要 iCloud+ 訂閱，但任何人都可以回覆邀请。', 'translate': 'You can download "Apple Invites" from the App Store. An iCloud+ subscription is required to create invitations, but anyone can RSVP.'}

{'text': 'Chance 精選推介：', 'translate': "Chance's picks:"}

  • {'text': 'AirPods Pro 3：234 美元（原價 249 美元）', 'translate': 'AirPods Pro 3: $234 (originally $249)'}
  • {'text': '將無線 CarPlay 帶到任何汽車', 'translate': 'Bring wireless CarPlay to any car'}
  • {'text': '《Apple: The First 50 Years》，作者 David Pogue', 'translate': 'Apple: The First 50 Years by David Pogue'}
  • {'text': 'Logitech MX Master 4', 'translate': 'Logitech MX Master 4'}
  • {'text': 'Belkin 3 合 1 MagSafe 充電器', 'translate': 'Belkin 3-in-1 MagSafe charger'}
  • {'text': 'Beats 布面 USB-C 充電線', 'translate': 'Beats fabric USB-C charging cables'}

{'text': '追蹤 Chance：Threads、Bluesky、Instagram 同 Mastodon。', 'translate': 'Follow Chance: Threads, Bluesky, Instagram, and Mastodon.'}
